name: House Listing & Housing Census
shortDescription: Focuses on houses, households, and amenities.
detailedDescription: During this phase, enumerators collect basic information about your house, housing conditions, and available amenities. This helps the government understand living standards.

categories.title: Housing Information
categories.description: Condition of the house, material of roof, wall, and floor.

categories.title: Basic Amenities
categories.description: Availability of drinking water, electricity, and sanitation facilities.

categories.title: Household Assets
categories.description: Information about vehicles, internet access, and cooking fuel.

name: Population Enumeration
shortDescription: Focuses on the people living in households.
detailedDescription: During this phase, enumerators count the members of your household and collect demographic data to understand population trends.

categories.title: Demographic Information
categories.description: Age, sex, marital status, and relation to the head of the household.

categories.title: Education & Economy
categories.description: Literacy status, educational attainment, and nature of economic activity.

categories.title: Social & Migration
categories.description: Information regarding migration, mother tongue, and caste/tribe if applicable.
